#### 1. epidermolysis bullosa simplex due to plakophilin deficiency  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.471)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-6809371, Reactome:R-HSA-6805567)

Pathogenic variants in KRT85 disrupt keratin intermediate filament organization, leading to hair and nail abnormalities characteristic of ectodermal dysplasia 4. Similarly, pathogenic variants in PKP1 disrupt the same keratin intermediate filament organization pathway, causing epidermolysis bullosa simplex due to the structural instability of epidermal cells.

**How to falsify it:** If mutations in KRT85 and PKP1 were found to act through entirely independent molecular pathways that do not converge on the keratin intermediate filament organization, or if pathogenic variants in either gene were extremely common in gnomAD (e.g., >0.1%), this hypothesis would be falsified. _(variant: rs747603839)_
